title: Prove P112 rank-five shortening through common support 45
body:
## Summary

```diff
- Three rank-five P112 pieces: sufficient common support <=44
+ Three rank-five P112 pieces: sufficient common support <=45
```

The new full-E8 closure check excludes PR3249's previously compatible equality. Ten singleton labels in an A2 fiber span five dimensions and contain every root label in that span. Their piece therefore cannot also have support twelve. The incidence budget becomes at most 63 while a putative two-dimensional code intersection needs at least 66.

Only `research/p112-a2-support45/` changes. Arbitrary characteristic-zero coefficients and dependent pieces are allowed. Global sharpness, actual TWOSIDE callers, full C5, decoder floor, supplier admission and kappa remain unclaimed. The selected result is unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before, the old count allowed equality at 45. After, all 8,001 fiber flats and 648 tight full-E8 closures verify the missing implication. A separately written root/label and five-label-basis implementation checks 242,190 subsets and agrees on every tight-flat set hash.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, eight optimized behavioral groups, Ruff and read-only Git-free CPython 3.13 replay pass. Internal read-only peer review found no blocking issue at the recorded hashes. CHECKS.json records exact coverage and review limits.
- Base is canonical main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, revision 6. PR3249 is pinned at `22c7bf316d55e59f381cc9ba833afccc7702fd58`; its unchanged proof/receipt are retained and authenticated for fresh CI. Credit Nick Petalas's geometry, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo.

Reproduce from the repository root with an external session TMPDIR:

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-a2-support45
```

The earlier global max-twelve census, A2 orbit/union, parabolic premises and written Weyl-chamber theorem are inherited, not rerun here. There was no selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human or proof-kernel review. At 46 the initial root count no longer forces E6/A2; this package stops at 45. Open next questions are recorded in README.md and TASK.json.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One source-pinned research package, including proof, exact evidence and replay. No shared checker or selected-frontier changes.
